name: T4_free_factor_layer

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: Merging two concepts keeps the factor layer free: congruence under a = b is agreement after the merge, whose image is the free monoid on the remaining concepts. An equation between products, a·b = c·d over four distinct concepts, leaves four distinct atoms with two factorizations of one element, while in a free monoid a product of two atoms factors one way.
